patthana24.11:1.1: Naappaccayaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaccayo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.11:2.1: Naappaccayaṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaccayo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ. (Saṅkhataṃ sappaccayasadisaṃ.)
patthana24.11:3.1: Nasanidassanaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassano hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.11:4.1: Nasanidassanaṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassano nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.11:5.1: Nasappaṭighaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.11:6.1: Nasappaṭighaṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.11:7.1: Narūpiṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca arūpī hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.11:8.1: Narūpiṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca arūpī nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… gaṇitakena tīṇi.
patthana24.11:9.1: Nalokiyaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokuttaro hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana24.11:10.1: Nalokuttaraṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. Hetuyā dve.
patthana24.11:11.1: Nalokiyaṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana24.11:12.1: Nalokuttaraṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. Hetuyā cattāri.
patthana24.11:13.1: Nakenaci viññeyyaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana24.11:14.1: Nakenaci naviññeyyaṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci naviññeyyo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
